name: Transaction
query:
SELECT
    t.scholarship AS "Scholarship Name",
    t.transaction_type AS "Scholarship Type",
    t.payment_id AS "Payment Id",
    t.paid_amount AS "Paid Amount",
    t.transaction_date AS "Transaction Date",
    a.name AS "Applicant Id"
FROM
    `tabTransaction` t
LEFT JOIN
    `tabApplicant Profile` a ON t.applicant = a.name
ORDER BY
    t.transaction_date DESC;
